archiveCard.title: Portable archive
archiveCard.introArchive: This page is a portable archive running in memory. Changes you make here are kept only if you save a new archive file.
archiveCard.introHosted: One .html file that contains Hearth itself and all your data. Double-click it in any desktop browser — on a USB stick, on another computer, years from now — and browse everything without installing anything. Import it here to bring the data back.
archiveCard.plaintextWarning: Without a passphrase the file contains plaintext genetic data and is named accordingly.
archiveCard.attachmentsNotice: The archive carries the health log, but not the attached documents; those live in your backup folder.
